name: Dynamic Social Cards
author: mediabandit

sections.description:
Dynamic Social Cards automatically generates beautiful social media cards for your WooCommerce products. When your products are shared on social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, or LinkedIn, they’ll stand out with professionally designed cards that include your product image, name, price, and branding.

Features

  • Automatic social card generation for products
  • Customizable card design with brand colors
  • Custom font selection and sizing
  • Logo placement options
  • Price and stock status display options
  • Bulk regeneration tool
  • Live preview in product editor
  • Proper Open Graph meta tags
  • Compatible with major SEO plugins

Key Benefits

  • Increase social media engagement
  • Improve click-through rates
  • Maintain brand consistency
  • Save time on social media graphics
  • Professional looking shares every time

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • GD library with FreeType support

External Services

This plugin uses the following external service for license management:

  • License Management Service (https://whatly.com)
    • Purpose: Handles license activation, validation, and deactivation for the plugin
    • Data Sent:
    • License key
    • Website URL
    • Product ID
    • Action type (activate/check/deactivate)
    • When Data is Sent:
    • During license activation
    • During periodic license checks
    • When manually deactivating the license
    • Terms of Service: https://whatly.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://whatly.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files through the WordPress plugins screen, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Social Cards to configure settings
  4. Generate cards for your products individually or use bulk generation
sections.faq:
How are the social cards generated?

Cards are generated using PHP’s GD library and are optimized for social media platforms. They follow the recommended dimensions and include your product details in a visually appealing layout.

Will this work with my SEO plugin?

Yes! Social Cards is compatible with popular SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO. It properly handles Open Graph meta tags to avoid conflicts.

Can I customize the card design?

Yes! You can customize:
* Colors for text and background
* Font choices and sizes
* Logo placement and size
* Information to display (price, stock status, etc.)
* Image position and padding
